historical_contract.calendar: Fixed inclusive UTC schedule; no moving, shortening, or extending after data availability.
historical_contract.common_sample_rule: A common integrity failure blocks the campaign; candidates may not receive candidate-specific row dropping or repaired windows.
historical_contract.shadow_observation_eligible: TRUE only as a separate governance flag after a deterministic historical admission gate; at most two candidates, zero permitted.
historical_contract.ranking: No leaderboard or ranking is produced for survival selection. Results are reported in preregistered candidate order.

statistics.adjustment: Holm step-down across exactly three raw two-sided p-values, ties ordered by candidate_id.
statistics.directionality: Each candidate is gated on its preregistered direction; opposite-sign evidence is not a success.
statistics.materiality: Each candidate's own frozen materiality rule must pass in addition to the adjusted inference gate.
statistics.minimum_observations: At least 90% of the fixed candidate schedule must be present, but any missingness still classifies BLOCKED_INTEGRITY rather than permitting row dropping; the 90% field is a documentation sanity bound, not a permission to execute incomplete input.
statistics.stochasticity: No bootstrap or stochastic procedure is used; no seed exists.

prequential_rules: persist feature/event/prediction receipt before outcome is known
scientific evaluation only at frozen maturity
prospective_observation_contract_v0.operational_visibility: Health, last event, missingness, uptime, clock drift, contract digest, and integrity state may be shown; rolling p-values, Sharpe, win rate, cumulative alpha, and candidate ranking must not drive mid-run decisions.

evidence_non_escalation: premium compression is not a funding trade
volatility predictability is not a directional return edge
historical discovery is not prospective confirmation
prospective confirmation is not economic value
economic value is not capital authority
prohibitions: no market-data materialization in this phase
